ani: FYI opened a small PR to address a flaky retry spec and a couple gemspec warnings. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/427

ani: CI is red on the bundler-2.4 job only. Locally all matrixes pass. The failing test is `retry_backoff_spec` which looks time-sensitive.

drew: Can you paste the failing assertion? Often these flake because we assert exact delay with sleep. Prefer to stub the HTTP client and assert number of attempts + that backoff lambda was called. Also Timecop.freeze is useful.

pat: Also seeing unrelated failures in bundle-2.4: `Gem::LoadError: incompatible ffi (~> 1.15) for x86_64-linux` on some runners that have older system gems. Might be runner image skew.

ani: Ugh. I copied the spec from the Python suite and didn't convert the timing semantics. I'll rewrite to stub Net::HTTP and check call_count.

lee: For the ffi issue we should loosen the dev dependency constraint and add a note to CI to use a clean gemset. I can push a tiny CI matrix tweak to use `bundle config set path vendor/bundle` and reinstall bundler for the matrix job.

ci-bot: CI: ruby-sdk (bundle-2.4) failed 11: https://ci.internal/redwood/ruby-sdk/812/logs

ani: Another thing: support flagged the sampleapp quickstart - new onboarding env var is `REDWOOD_KEY` but README still shows `REDWOOD_API_KEY`. Can we update docs and the quickstart script with a short token refresh example?

drew: I'll add a minimal refresh snippet showing a refresh_token flow and recommend the SDK helper: `client.auth.refresh_if_needed!` in the sample. Example I plan to add: 

```ruby
# quickstart snippet
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV.fetch("REDWOOD_KEY"))
# auto-refresh helper
begin
  client.auth.refresh_if_needed!
rescue Redwood::Auth::NeedLoginError
  puts "Please re-authenticate"
end
```

pat: Sounds good. For the retry spec change, please replace sleeps with a fake HTTP adapter and assert attempts. That will make CI stable.

ani: Updated the spec and gemspec (loosened ffi dev constraint), and added the README edits. Pushing now.

ci-bot: CI: ruby-sdk (bundle-2.4) running build #813

lee: I also added a small CI runner bootstrap step to ensure a clean bundler - that should avoid the system gem mix.

ci-bot: CI: ruby-sdk (bundle-2.4) success 10 - build 813. Patch release candidate tagged (v0.14.4-rc).

ani: Great! Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a quick changelog entry and close the onboarding support ticket. :tada:
